items.description: Jardin Zoologique Ouaga is a small urban zoo in Ouagadougou. It gives families a place to see animals without leaving the capital.
Oasis de Ourou is a green resting place in a dry landscape. It stands out as a small water-rich spot with local leisure value.
Reserve de Faune de Kouritenga is a wildlife reserve in eastern Burkina Faso. It protects animals and habitat in a farming region.
Parc de Loisirs de Bobo-Dioulasso is a recreation space for the city. It serves as a place for outings, relaxation, and local events.
Reserve de Faune de Boulon is a protected wildlife area in southwestern Burkina Faso. It adds conservation value to a landscape shaped by savanna and woodland.
Aire de Jeux de Ouaga 2000 is a play area in one of Ouagadougou’s newer districts. It is designed for children and local family use.
Cotton cultivation is one of Burkina Faso’s most important rural activities. It ties western farming areas to the country’s export economy.
Centre Equestre de Ouaga is an equestrian facility in the capital. It supports horse riding, training, and leisure activity in the city.
Peanut cultivation remains a familiar part of rural life in Burkina Faso. It supports household farming and local food markets.
Parc de la Reunification is a public park used for leisure and social gatherings. It offers open green space within an urban setting.
Ferme Avicole Ouaga is a poultry farm serving the capital area. It helps supply eggs and chicken to a dense urban market.
Jardin Botanique Ouaga is a botanical garden in Ouagadougou. It combines plant display, education, and a quiet place to walk.
Reserve de Faune de Bontioli Nord is part of a protected wildlife zone in the southwest. It helps preserve animals and vegetation in a dry seasonal climate.
Maize cultivation is a core part of everyday farming in Burkina Faso. It supports both household consumption and local market sales.
